Hi Sanjay / Alex,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand CareCo's throughput patterns and where you surface the most latency-sensitive user journeys. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you run inference for clinical summarization and search re-ranking; peak traffic is 12–2pm ET and you have strict PII controls for PHI.
- Ask from our side: confirm whether the demo should focus on Hosted API or a Dedicated assessment (we recommended starting hosted with a Dedicated capacity cost projection).
- Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive where we can show a short live demo (20 min), go over model/quantization tradeoffs, and review network/VPC options for PHI handling.

I've attached a simple timezone grid (CareCo-timezone-grid.xlsx) with three proposed windows that map to your engineering overlap:
  • Option A: Wed 10 Mar — 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
  • Option B: Thu 11 Mar — 14:00–15:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 ET
  • Option C: Fri 12 Mar — 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET

Please reply with the preferred slot and the final attendee roster (we've tentatively suggested: Sanjay (PO), Alex (Eng), +1 infra). If you want us to include our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) and an infra lead (Karthik), happy to add them — I cc'd both.

I also attached a brief mutual action plan so we can capture deliverables and decision criteria ahead of the deep-dive.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
